licenseTypesIncluded: Maryland plumbing and gas license records exposed by the official plumbers public query
Master, journeyperson, apprentice, natural gas fitter, propane gas fitter, and plumbing inspector classifications referenced by the board
knownExclusions: This source is scoped to Maryland statewide plumbing and gas licenses and does not represent Baltimore County or WSSC plumbing licenses, local permits, inspections, or unrelated contractor credentials.
The board states its licenses are required statewide except Baltimore County and WSSC-served areas of Prince George's and Montgomery Counties.
Pool/spa and mechanical work may require additional electrical, HVACR, building, health, and local approvals.
